summary: No undo exists anywhere on the canvas today - a grep for undo across js/ returns comments only. Tolerable for masks (regenerable), fatal for paint, so MPI-375 is the driver. Shape: a command stack owned by MpiCanvas, one stroke per command, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z through Hotkeys with registry ids, bounded depth, cleared on entry switch and teardown. Memory is the real design constraint - a full 1536 RGBA snapshot is ~9MB so prefer dirty-rect patches over snapshots. Masking undo is CONDITIONAL: extend it only if it is not a refactor of MaskManager's four layers plus the MPI-371 auto-picks-union-LAST ordering; otherwise split it onto its own card rather than half-wiring it.

USER RESTEER: masks become a first-class driver of undo rather than the conditional half, and the card moves between MPI-382 and MPI-379. Add/Subtract bakes are already irreversible and MPI-382 rewrites the layer in one gesture. Rewritten to planned with 9 acceptance items - enumerate undoable units from code, restore the MPI-371 layer order not just pixels, survive a tool swap, one stack shared with paint (MPI-375).
User resequenced 376 AHEAD of 382. New order: 376 > 382 > 368 > 379.

MASK UNDO CORE LANDED (not yet exercised in-app). The card's MaskManager-restructure stop-rule did NOT trigger: manualCanvas + subtractCanvas are the only persistent layers, maskCanvas and autoCanvas are derived by _recomposite(), so undo restores the two source layers and re-derives - the MPI-371 auto-picks-union-LAST order lives in the compositor and cannot be broken by an undo. New js/components/Primitives/MpiCanvas/managers/UndoStack.js: layer-agnostic, SWAP-based (one snapshot per entry drives both undo and redo), dirty-rect for strokes via begin()/commit(box) over a reused scratch buffer, full-rect record() for layer-wide ops, byte-budget eviction (96MB) instead of a fixed depth. Undoable units enumerated from code, not guessed - the complete manual/subtract mutation set is paint(), clear(), bakeAutoPicksInto(), setManualFromDataURL(), setSubtractFromDataURL(), init(). Wired: MpiCanvas owns the stack and exposes undoMask/redoMask/clearMaskUndo/canUndoMask/canRedoMask; InputController opens the capture at mousedown and closes it in _endMaskStroke (which Space-pan also calls); hotkeyRegistry gains mask.undo.canvas (control+z) and mask.redo.canvas (control+shift+z). TRAP FOUND: allowWhileTyping:false does NOT block control+z (not a single letter, bare modifier or text-edit key), so both entries carry when:({isTyping})=>!isTyping or the manager would preventDefault Ctrl+Z inside the PromptBox and eat native text undo. Stack clears on image load via mask.init() and on _restoreLayers() (the re-seed path clearMask()es without reloading). Undo reuses onMaskStrokeEnd so the op strip resyncs through the existing _publishMaskState path. UndoStack.pendingLayer(i) added for MPI-382's pristine drag-start snapshot. Scope per user: PIXELS ONLY - autoPickMasks/selectedAutoPicks/points are transient and NOT restored. tests/undo-stack.test.cjs 8/8; suite 253/262 with the same 9 pre-existing failures. NOT YET DONE: in-app smoke, the measured per-entry byte number, docs/masking.md entry.

LIVE SMOKE PASSED on a real project/entry, strokes driven as real mouse events so the full InputController -> MaskManager -> UndoStack path ran. Undo/redo land on EXACT pre-edit pixel counts; Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z fire end-to-end; Ctrl+Z inside a TEXTAREA leaves the mask untouched (the when:isTyping guard holds, native text undo preserved); eraser stroke (writes BOTH layers) restores exactly; Clear undoes exactly; history survives a mask-tool swap and is dropped on entry switch; viewer.hasMask() flips false/true/false so the op strip resyncs. MEASURED on a 912x1140 layer: stroke 59-73KB, full-layer op 7.93MB, stroke <1% of a snapshot (18.9MB at MASK_MAX_EDGE). BUG FOUND AND FIXED BY THE SMOKE: `bytes` never credited back a DISCARDED redo branch, so undo-then-edit-again inflated the total (depth 2 reporting 3 entries) and would evict live history early - fixed in _push(), re-measured clean, new unit test guards it (9/9). Docs SPLIT: masking.md hit 212 lines so undo moved to docs/masking-undo.md with a pointer; routed in docs/README.md + CLAUDE.md. NOT COVERED: Add/Subtract bake undo (needs the engine for a detect run) and Electron desktop. Unrelated defect seen: the 18+ age gate leaves an orphan full-viewport .mpi-modal-backdrop (z 10009, pointer-events auto) that blocks all landing-page clicks - uncarded, browser-repro only.

Card stays doing/validating - NOT done - because Add/Subtract bake undo needs an engine for a detect run and is unexercised; everything else was live-verified. Undo CONTRACT propagated to the three cards that will mutate layers next (MPI-382/368/375), the CLAUDE.md Critical Rules Snapshot, .claude/rules/dos_and_donts.md, the MaskManager header and docs/masking-undo.md - a mutation that skips the stack is a silent hole in Ctrl+Z. Board To do physically reordered to 382 > 368 > 379 so the order is the board. Next-session handoff: handoffs/next-session.md

Nothing in the measured record changes - the bake shares the layer-wide _recordUndo() path that clear() already proved restores exactly (10568 -> 0 -> 10568), so the user's run covered the one uncovered call site rather than a different mechanism. Undo/redo itself was already live-verified in 7db2aad0 across 15 checks with exact pixel-count matches both directions, dirty-rect cost measured at 59-73KB per stroke against 7.93MB for a layer-wide op, and a real bug found and fixed BY that smoke (discarded redo branches leaked their bytes forever, inflating the budget and evicting live history early). Also corrected on the card: the orphan-backdrop defect this smoke incidentally reported (carded MPI-386) DID NOT REPRODUCE on a re-run of its own repro, and the observation was a misread - a live MpiModal backdrop is legitimately childless because MpiModal.js:57-63 builds it as a separate element from .mpi-modal-wrapper.
